title: 戳印序列
summary: 从问号串开始，每次把 stamp 覆盖到一个位置，求不超过十倍目标长度的操作序列生成 target；无解返回空数组。
insight: 反向思考为擦除 target：某窗口的未擦字符都与 stamp 对应位置相同且至少能新擦一个字符时即可擦除；持续贪心直到全为星号。
pitfalls: 窗口中已有星号可匹配任意字符
一次操作必须新擦除至少一个字符
反向擦除位置收集后要逆序返回

solutions.title: 反向贪心擦除
solutions.idea: 不断擦除当前可与印章匹配的窗口。
steps: 把 target 转字符数组，done 标记已使用窗口
循环扫描所有窗口；若未擦字符均匹配且存在未擦字符，则置星并记录位置
若一轮无进展且尚未全擦返回空；全部擦除后逆序 moves

code.java: class Solution { public int[] movesToStamp(String stamp,String target){char[] text=target.toCharArray();boolean[] done=new boolean[target.length()-stamp.length()+1];List<Integer> moves=new ArrayList<>();int erased=0;while(erased<text.length){boolean changed=false;for(int start=0;start<done.length;start++)if(!done[start]&&canErase(text,stamp,start)){int added=erase(text,start,stamp.length());if(added>0){erased+=added;changed=true;done[start]=true;moves.add(start);}}if(!changed)return new int[0];}Collections.reverse(moves);return moves.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();}private boolean canErase(char[] text,String stamp,int start){boolean fresh=false;for(int i=0;i<stamp.length();i++)if(text[start+i]!='*'){if(text[start+i]!=stamp.charAt(i))return false;fresh=true;}return fresh;}private int erase(char[] text,int start,int length){int count=0;for(int i=0;i<length;i++)if(text[start+i]!='*'){text[start+i]='*';count++;}return count;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun movesToStamp(stamp:String,target:String):IntArray{val text=target.toCharArray();val done=BooleanArray(target.length-stamp.length+1);val moves=mutableListOf<Int>();var erased=0;while(erased<text.size){var changed=false;for(start in done.indices)if(!done[start]&&canErase(text,stamp,start)){val added=erase(text,start,stamp.length);if(added>0){erased+=added;changed=true;done[start]=true;moves.add(start)}};if(!changed)return intArrayOf()};return moves.asReversed().toIntArray()};private fun canErase(text:CharArray,stamp:String,start:Int):Boolean{var fresh=false;for(i in stamp.indices)if(text[start+i]!='*'){if(text[start+i]!=stamp[i])return false;fresh=true};return fresh};private fun erase(text:CharArray,start:Int,length:Int):Int{var count=0;for(i in 0 until length)if(text[start+i]!='*'){text[start+i]='*';count++};return count} }
code.cpp: class Solution { bool canErase(string& text,string& stamp,int start){bool fresh=false;for(int i=0;i<(int)stamp.size();++i)if(text[start+i]!='*'){if(text[start+i]!=stamp[i])return false;fresh=true;}return fresh;}int erase(string& text,int start,int length){int count=0;for(int i=0;i<length;++i)if(text[start+i]!='*'){text[start+i]='*';++count;}return count;}public:vector<int> movesToStamp(string stamp,string target){vector<bool> done(target.size()-stamp.size()+1);vector<int> moves;int erased=0;while(erased<(int)target.size()){bool changed=false;for(int start=0;start<(int)done.size();++start)if(!done[start]&&canErase(target,stamp,start)){int added=erase(target,start,stamp.size());if(added){erased+=added;changed=true;done[start]=true;moves.push_back(start);}}if(!changed)return {};}reverse(moves.begin(),moves.end());return moves;} };
